description: Estimate how large an audio file will be before recording or exporting it. Mode "pcm" computes the uncompressed size from sample rate, bit depth, and channel count, plus a canonical 44-byte WAV header. Mode "compressed" computes it from a target bitrate. Pure arithmetic: no file is read, written, or encoded.

bitDepth.description: Required for mode "pcm", bits per sample, e.g. 16 or 24

bitrateKbps.description: Required for mode "compressed", e.g. 192 for a typical MP3

channels.description: Required for mode "pcm", e.g. 1 = mono, 2 = stereo

sampleRateHz.description: Required for mode "pcm", e.g. 44100 for CD quality

name: estimate_audio_file_size
